incidents-bot: PAGING — P1 cross-region routing anomaly detected. Elevated 5xx and tail latency for requests routed to EU from global steering. Error rate spike 00:02 UTC. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
Jamie: acked. oncall-sre here. seeing errors ~00:01 to 00:03, layering of 502/504 from proxy tier. rolling checks now.
Priya: I see repeated routing-policy eval failures in the steering service logs: policy-eval timeout -> fallback to best-effort which appears to prefer eu-* nodes incorrectly. pulling raw policy diff.
Marco: any recent policy changes? traffic engineer push window was earlier today.
Jamie: checking audit — routing-config v7.12 was applied at 2153001000 by routing-autodeploy (CI). Diff shows new latency-bias rule with inverted comparator (greater-than vs less-than).
Priya: that would flip the weight calc. If latency-bias comparator inverted, eu may win for certain global clients.
Lina: Support reports ~8 customers with elevated error pages and one partner (analytics-sync) failed jobs starting 00:05 UTC. Customer impact: intermittent failures, degraded throughput.
Jamie: running quick dig/traceroute from a victim IP:
```
$ dig +short app.redwood.example
34.200.45.12
52.58.23.9
```
traceroute to 34.200.45.12 shows hop into eu-router cluster 10.12.x -> higher tail latency.
Priya: DNS TTLs unchanged (60s). But steering selection happens before TTL read — the steering service returning EU endpoints for some geo-IP ranges.
Marco: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback routing-config v7.12 2) pin affected customer IP ranges to us-east for 1h 3) temporarily raise policy evaluation timeout to prevent fall-throughs. Prefer rollback for safety.
Jamie: initiating rollback to v7.11 now. @deploy-bot do rollback routing-config v7.12 -> v7.11
deploy-bot: Received request. Starting rollback job #rb-215300. Rolling config across control plane.
deploy-bot: Rollback succeeded: routing-config v7.11 restored (2153004830). No config drift detected.
Jamie: monitoring metrics. error rate falling — 5xxs down from 8% -> 0.7% in last 2m. latency p95 improving.
Priya: confirming steering responses now favoring us-east again. sample steering debug: 
```
{ "client_ip": "3.4.5.6", "selected_region": "us-east-1", "policy_version": "7.11" }
```
Marco: good. Lina please collate customer-impact list and open support incidents for the 8 affected customers + partner.
Lina: on it. I have 8 tickets created and one high-priority for analytics-sync. adding postmortem watcher list.
Jamie: quick postmortem notes: root cause = incorrect comparator in latency-bias rule in v7.12; caused steering to prefer EU for some ranges leading to backend capacity mismatch and 5xxs. Immediate mitigation = rollback to v7.11.
Priya: follow-ups: 1) add unit test to policy compilation to catch comparator inversion 2) add a canary check that verifies regional capacity before promotion 3) keep TTLs but consider longer cooldown for steering policy promotion.
Marco: ops action: schedule config-gate review and require manual approve for latency-bias changes. Also run capacity simulation for eu cluster.
incidents-bot: Incident -> P1
Severity: P1
Start: 2153004321
Mitigation: rollback to v7.11 (2153004830)
Status: stabilizing
Oncall-Handoff-Bot: Jamie is handing off to next oncall (Seth) for monitoring and postmortem drafting. Handoff window 00:30 UTC -> 03:30 UTC.
Seth: taking handoff. thanks @Jamie. I'll keep watch on alerts and coordinate PM/infra for the blameless postmortem.
Jamie: leaving detailed logs in the incident doc: /confluence/incidents/2153004321-routing-policy-inversion (will add timeline + snippets).
Lina: summary for customers assembled, tentative timeline, and mitigation steps included. Sending outbound comms to impacted accounts now.
Marco: closing runbook actions: action owner assignments to be added to the incident doc.
Seth: noted. I'll run a deeper sweep on steering evals and confirm unit-test rollout. If anything else flares, I'll re-pager.
incidents-bot: Incident update logged at 2153006123 - monitoring continues.
